TITLE:
Two pencils
feel like one point?
NEXT:
NEXT: The same water
feels cold AND warm?

EN.연필 두 자루를 나란히 붙여\n뭉툭한 쪽을 아래로:
Hold two pencils side by side,
blunt ends down
EN.살짝 누르고 물어봐요\n\"하나? 둘?\":
Press lightly and ask
"One or two?"
EN.이번엔 팔뚝을 똑같이: Now the forearm, the same way
EN.어? 하나뿐인 것 같아요!: Huh? It feels like just one!
EN.피부에는 닿는 걸 느끼는\n세포가 구역을 나눠 맡아요:
Touch-sensing cells in your skin
each take care of their own patch
EN.손끝은 빽빽해서\n두 점이 다른 세포에 닿아요:
Fingertips are packed tight,
so the two points hit different cells
EN.팔뚝은 듬성듬성해서\n두 점이 한 세포에 같이 닿아요:
The forearm is sparse,
so both points land on one cell
EN.한 세포가 보낸 신호는 하나\n→ 뇌는 \"한 점\"이라고 느껴요:
One cell sends one signal
→ the brain feels "one point"
EN.그래서 손끝으로\n작은 점자도 읽을 수 있어요:
That's why fingertips
can read tiny braille dots
EN.손등 · 볼 · 발바닥은 어떨까요?: What about the back of the hand, cheek, or sole?
